name: SubscriptionStatusCard
title: Subscription status card
description: A billing-page card showing the current plan, a status badge (active/trialing/past-due/…), the renewal date, and a manage/upgrade button. Presentational — the page passes the subscription (from the Better Auth Stripe client) and an onManage handler that opens the customer portal.

i18nKeys.subscriptionstatuscard__none: You're not subscribed to a plan yet.
